About this item

  • 2 BREW STYLES: Classic or Rich, each brew is flavorful and never bitter with custom brew strengths.
  • 14-CUP CARAFE: Brew large batches of coffee—perfect for entertaining.
  • HOTTER BREWING TECHNOLOGY: Delivers even saturation and temperature control for ultra-flavorful coffee.
  • SMALL BATCH FUNCTION: Ensure your coffee is never diluted when brewing a small batch (1–4 cups).
  • WAKE UP TO HOT COFFEE: 24-hour programmable delay brew allows you to prepare your brew up to a day in advance.

  • FRESHNESS TIMER: Always know when your last pot was brewed.
  • MID-BREW PAUSE: Pour yourself a cup before the brew is complete.
  • INCLUDES: 14-cup glass carafe, permanent filter, & Ninja scoop.

Product Description

The Ninja Programmable XL 14-Cup Coffee Maker PRO is a sleek coffee maker that delivers on quality flavor and capacity. With Hotter Brewing Technology, you can enjoy Classic and Rich coffee strengths that are hot and never bitter. Keep your carafe of coffee hot for up to 4 hours with the variable warming plate. Also featured are a removable reservoir, delay brew function, and freshness timer.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers praise the coffee maker's ability to keep coffee hot for hours without scorching or changing the taste, and appreciate its ease of use, with one noting its simple one-button operation. The machine receives positive feedback for its appearance and taste, with one customer highlighting how the reusable filter preserves coffee flavor. While some customers report the machine functions well and is worth the money, others mention it stops working after 5 weeks and consider it not worth the cost. The leakage aspect is mixed, with some customers reporting no spilling issues while others experience coffee spilling when pouring.
